subject: general
question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. B is taller than F but shorter than E. Only one person is shorter than D. Only three people are taller than C. F is not the shortest. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
**Given: **Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. 

1) Only one person is shorter than D.

2) Only three people are taller than C.

_ > _ > _ > C > D > _

3) B is taller than F but shorter than E.

4) F is not the shortest.

After positioning B, F and E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. A.

E > B > F > C > D > A

Thus, according to the final arrangement, A is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
